The current text is [[The Empire's Back (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). * '''PC-E1''' (this page): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata (Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf)<ref name="sheet23-20240802">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 9 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file created 2 August 2024). Released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 3, file created 2 August 2024: “USED: ▼ Empire's New Order or Overseeing It Personally. LOST: Once per game, choose: Place an opponent's just-played Interrupt out of play. OR If Xizor (or two Imperial leaders) in battle, re-circulate.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[The Empire's Back (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “The Empire’s Back”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[The Empire's Back (V)]] (published 21 July 2024) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[The Empire's Back]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[The Empire's Back (V) (Errata 2)]]): the errata card image (7 March 2026, for the PC's 2026 errata (“Tweak Set 2026”))<ref name="ht-23b4dc9">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/23b4dc91123cec2827f5084f60e2378f88594306/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Dark/large/theempiresback.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual23-Dark/large/theempiresback.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/23b4dc91123cec2827f5084f60e2378f88594306 23b4dc9] “DS Errata”, 7 March 2026, for the PC's 2026 errata (“Tweak Set 2026”).</ref> prints: “If two Imperials (or two Black Sun agents) in battle, re-circulate and shuffle your Reserve Deck. OR Once per game, if Emperor or Tarkin on table, Allegations Of Corruption stacks opponent’s just played Interrupt; this does not count toward that card’s once per game limit.”<ref name="cj-12dc019">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/12dc019 swccg-card-json commit 12dc019] “Tweak Set 2026 - Dark” (14 March 2026) changed the card to this wording.</ref> '''What changed:''' The card became a Lost Interrupt (it was a Used or Lost Interrupt) and was rewritten. Removed: the USED ▼ of Empire’s New Order or Overseeing It Personally and “Place an opponent’s just-played Interrupt out of play”. The re-circulate option became “If two Imperials (or two Black Sun agents) in battle, re-circulate and shuffle your Reserve Deck.” (was “If Xizor (or two Imperial leaders) in battle”), and “OR Once per game, if Emperor or Tarkin on table, Allegations Of Corruption stacks opponent’s just played Interrupt; this does not count toward that card’s once per game limit.” was added. The card image prints the errata mark “E1” at bottom right.
